title: CommonProperty
description: An identifiable area of common property, including limited common property designated for the exclusive use of one or more strata lots.
x-validationRules: designatedStrataLotIds must contain at least one value when kind is limitedCommonProperty.
designatedStrataLotIds must be empty or absent when kind is commonProperty.
x-legalReviewNotes: Confirm how designation method (on the plan, or by resolution) should be recorded.

id.description: Stable identifier of this CommonProperty record.

strataCorporationId.description: The strata corporation this record belongs to.

description.description: Description of the area (for example "Parking stall 14", "Rooftop deck").

kind.description: Whether the area is general or limited common property.

x-enumDescriptions.commonProperty: Common property available to all owners.
x-enumDescriptions.limitedCommonProperty: Common property designated for the exclusive use of the owners of one or more strata lots.

designatedStrataLotIds.description: Strata lots with exclusive use, when kind is limitedCommonProperty.

buildingId.description: Building the area is in or attached to, if applicable.

extensions.description: Implementation-specific data, namespaced by reverse domain.
